insights.title: Action-Efficiency Gap Against Optimal and Human Play
insights.summary: Best evaluated model (Mock Model) achieved 0.252 action-efficiency score (33.3% levels solved), leaving a 0.748 gap behind BFS optimal (1.000) due to exploration overhead and budget exhaustion.

insights.title: Models Spend Budget on Repeated No-Effect Actions and Detours
insights.summary: Across observed model steps, agents lose move budget bumping into walls or repeating actions whose playfield diff is zero instead of updating spatial constraints immediately.

evidence.label: Mean Wasted Actions on Intro Levels

insights.title: Reset Timing and Multi-Level Budget Horizon Limit Game Completion
insights.summary: Models struggle to detect wasted trajectories early: calling RESET only after walking deep into dead-ends consumes irrecoverable per-level and per-game action budget.

insights.title: Reward Integrity: Zero-Effort Baselines Score Strictly Zero
insights.summary: Action-efficiency scoring (min(1, optimal_moves / actions_used) per solved level) assigns 0.000 to noop and stop_early, penalizes reset farming, and rewards only genuine level completion.
